Episodes.Description: Mereoleona Vermillion, the new captain of the Crimson Lion Kings, takes the squad (and a few Black Bulls) along for training in a strong magic region.

Episodes.Title: Saint Elmo’s Fire
Episodes.Description: Asta attempts to tap into his mysterious dark powers so he can make it to Mereoleona’s hot spring training camp. Noelle learns about her late mother.

Episodes.Title: The Royal Knights Selection Test
Episodes.Description: Magic Knights from every squad gather for the test that will determine who’ll be a Royal Knight. The vice-captain of the Purple Orcas causes a stir.

Episodes.Title: Flower of Resolution
Episodes.Description: Round 1 of the tournament sees Asta and Mimosa teaming up for a heated battle against three skilled senior Magic Knights. But what happened to Xerx?

Episodes.Title: Fierce Battle
Episodes.Description: The tournament continues as Magna and Sol fight alongside the conceited Kirsch Vermillion and Finral takes a risk with teammates Leopold and Hamon.

Episodes.Title: Mage X
Episodes.Description: A mystery mage with a tortured past joins the competition with unconventional but powerful magic, taking everyone by surprise—friend and foe alike.

Episodes.Title: Bad Blood
Episodes.Description: It’s Noelle chance to prove to her brother Solid that she’s far from a failure, while Alecdora Sandler takes out his jealousy on the upstart Yuno.

Episodes.Title: Peasant Trap
Episodes.Description: Narcissist royal Kirsch takes offense at having to battle Asta the commoner, but Asta has some new tricks up his sleeve that catch Zora off guard.

Episodes.Title: Mister Delinquent vs. Muscle Brains
Episodes.Description: It’s not looking good for Asta’s team; even anti-magic Asta has his hands full guarding their crystal from squadmate Magna’s powerful new Flame spell.

Episodes.Title: Special Little Brother vs. Failed Big Brother
Episodes.Description: The long-awaited showdown between Finral and Langris has come around at last, and gentle Finral must prove himself to his cutthroat little brother.

Episodes.Title: The Life of a Certain Man
Episodes.Description: The Magic Knights question Langris’ sanity as he challenges Asta to a fight in the middle of the tournament. Zora recalls his Magic Knight father.

Episodes.Title: Petit Clover! The Nightmarish Charmy SP!
Episodes.Description: In a break from all the action, a forest-foraging Charmy falls victim to a mind-altering mushroom that gives her vivid visions of Clover Clips past.

Episodes.Title: Burn It Into You
Episodes.Description: The semifinal bout between Asta and Langris comes to a grim conclusion. Luck has a plan that could give his team the edge over Aqua Deer captain Rill.

Episodes.Title: The Victors
Episodes.Description: It’s the final match in the Royal Knights Selection Test. Rill seeks inspiration for his masterpiece; Yuno and Bell are ready to try something new.

Episodes.Title: Together in the Bath
Episodes.Description: Yami suggests a leisurely bath to get Asta out of his funk. While there, he reminisces about his first battle alongside the masked William Vangeance.

Episodes.Title: Yami and Vangeance
Episodes.Description: Yami tells another tale of his younger days in the Magic Knights: a top-secret mission given to him and William Vangeance by the Wizard King himself.

Episodes.Title: Formation of the Royal Knights
Episodes.Description: Those who have passed the Royal Knights Selection Test assemble for the first time to be briefed on their mission: defeat the Eye of the Midnight Sun.

Episodes.Title: Storming the Eye of the Midnight Sun’s Hideout!!!
Episodes.Description: The Royal Knights relocate to the royal capital in preparation for their attack on the floating dungeon in Gravito Stones. Klaus warns of enemy spies.

Episodes.Title: The Black Bulls’ Hideout
Episodes.Description: Gauche, Gordon, and Grey are holding down the fort when the hideout is attacked by some familiar faces. The trio must work fast to defend their home.

Episodes.Title: Crazy Magic Battle
Episodes.Description: The Black Bulls learn why their home base keeps changing shape; that same power is put to the test against members of the Eye of the Midnight Sun.

Episodes.Title: Mereoleona vs. Raia the Disloyal
Episodes.Description: Fierce fighter Mereoleona takes on Raia of the Third Eye and his wide range of formidable Copy Magic spells as Zora tries to figure out how they work.

Episodes.Title: The Wizard King vs. The Leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun
Episodes.Description: It’s a battle for the ages as the Clover Kingdom’s mightiest mage takes on the dynamic leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun—and an unexpected guest.

Episodes.Title: Julius Novachrono
Episodes.Description: The battle rages on between the Wizard King and Licht, who holds a kingdom’s worth of innocent people hostage. Julius recalls his greatest motivation.

Episodes.Title: New Future
Episodes.Description: Yami rushes to Julius’ side as the Wizard King’s battle with Licht draws to a close. Yuno’s team approaches the center of the terrorist’s hideout.

Episodes.Title: Reincarnation
Episodes.Description: A look into the origins of Licht’s hatred of humans and the complicated ways by which the Third Eye—and Licht as he is today—came to be.

Episodes.Title: The Black Bulls Captain vs. the Crimson Wild Rose
Episodes.Description: It’s Yami versus the elves: first Marx and Owen, then an elf-possessed Charlotte who seems bent on destroying the royal capital and everyone in it.

Episodes.Title: Overwhelming Disadvantage
Episodes.Description: Royal Knights and disgraced mages alike encounter friends and squadmates whose bodies have been taken over by reincarnated elves. Can Black Asta help?

Episodes.Title: The Sleeping Lion
Episodes.Description: The vice-captain of the Crimson Lion Kings, now a reincarnated elf, turns on his squadmates with powerful Air Magic. A mighty beast awakens at last.

Episodes.Title: The Desperate Path Toward Survival
Episodes.Description: Mereoleona is left to face five powerful elf enemies alone, putting her “undefeated” title to the test. Mimosa’s Royal Knight teammates turn on her.

Episodes.Title: We Won’t Lose to You
Episodes.Description: Asta confronts his rival, Yuno, one of many Golden Dawn members to have been taken over by elves. Licht is spurred to action, as are Yami and Finral.

Episodes.Title: The Lives of the Village in the Sticks
Episodes.Description: Even remote little Hage Village is not immune from the chaos overtaking the Clover Kingdom. Asta and Yuno are determined to fight for their hometown.

Episodes.Title: Two Miracles
Episodes.Description: As Asta and Yuno battle a Poison Plant mage, Sister Lily recalls the letters they would send home. The priest is in a bad way; can Asta’s sword help?

Episodes.Title: Release from Misfortune
Episodes.Description: As the elves set their sights on the royal capital, bent on destroying all humankind, Asta’s newest sword may be the key to driving them out for good.

Episodes.Title: Lightning of Rage vs. Friends
Episodes.Description: After a chance encounter with their squadmate Luck, Magna and Vanessa go to extremes in a struggle to free their friend from a crazed elf’s clutches.

Episodes.Title: Smiles, Tears
Episodes.Description: Asta and friends stop by the ruined Black Bulls hideout to check in with their squadmates before pursuing the reincarnated elves to the royal capital.

Episodes.Title: Path of Revenge, Path of Atonement
Episodes.Description: Fueled by Charmy’s magical meals, Asta’s team detours to defend Hecairo on their way to the royal capital and picks up a trio of most unlikely allies.

Episodes.Title: The Battle for Clover Castle
Episodes.Description: Yami and Finral take on possessed members of the Golden Dawn; Noelle and Nozel must defend their siblings when the Silva family home is under siege.

Episodes.Title: Battlefield Dancer
Episodes.Description: Noelle must think outside the box to gain the upper hand in the pitched battle at House Silva. Thoughts of her mother help her push past her limits.

Episodes.Title: Spatial Mage Brothers
Episodes.Description: While Mimosa, Kirsch, and En were protecting the Vermillion residence from the elves, Langris, who had reincarnated as an elf, had arrived at the castle. He goes after the king’s life but Finral shows up with Captain Yami and Captain Jack. Despite knowing the difference in power between him and his younger brother, Finral continues to support Captain Yami and Captain Jack in this fight against Langris. Finral goes for a risky attack which injures him, and…

Episodes.Title: The Raging Bull Joins the Showdown!!
Episodes.Description: As the battle at Clover Castle continues the Shadow Palace appears. Captain Yami and Captain Jack get a bad feeling about this, so they try to infiltrate the palace, but Magic Knights who had reincarnated as elves keep getting in their way. Then Asta and the other Black Bulls as well as Rades, Sally, and Valtos arrive! Asta tries to undo the reincarnation spell that’s been cast on the Magic Knights, but then the Captain of the Coral Peacocks, Dorothy Unsworth, who has also reincarnated as an elf appears before them!

Episodes.Title: The Eyes in the Mirror
Episodes.Description: Due to Captain Dorothy’s magic, Vanessa, who can use magic to alter fate and Charmy, who can use magic to recover mana had disappeared. Asta and the remaining Black Bulls have lost the bulk of their defense and are now struggling against Gauche and Marie’s combo magic being used against them. Meanwhile, Vanessa and her team try to figure out how to get out of Captain Dorothy’s dream world.

Episodes.Title: Humans Who Can Be Trusted
Episodes.Description: Vanessa and her team are able to figure out how to leave Captain Dorothy’s Glamour World due to quick thinking on Sally’s part, but it’s easier said than done. But then Luck gets an idea to help them out. Meanwhile, Asta continues to try to undo the reincarnation spell on Gauche and Marie but can’t even get close to them. Henry sees this and decides to make a great sacrifice…

Episodes.Title: Storming the Shadow Palace
Episodes.Description: After their last battle, Asta and some of the others decide to chase after Captain Yami and some others who had already headed into the Shadow Palace. However, the elves get in their way. It was then that Captain Fuegoleon and Captain Mereoleona, both who had just awakened, showed off their true powers. Asta and the others are happy to have their help, but then notice that the door to the Shadow Palace closing. In order to get Asta and his group into the palace, the other Black Bulls hold off the elves outside.

Episodes.Title: The Final Invaders
Episodes.Description: The Black Bulls fight off the elves as Asta and the captains head into the Shadow Palace. However, they start to feel cornered from being so run down from one battle after another. It was then that Yuno had finally arrived to save them, bringing other Magic Knights he found throughout the land with him. Yuno hears the situation from Charmy and decides to head into the Shadow Palace, too. However, the entrance was now closed. But then, his pendant starts to react in a strange way…

Episodes.Title: Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Yuno manages to enter the Shadow Palace with his pendant and runs into Patry and the others. However, his pendant is immediately stolen. Now, all of the necessary magic stones have been collected and the elves’ wish was supposed to come true. However, an uninvited guest appears before them: A devil from another world. They find out everything that happened between the elves and humans were actually a part of his plan all along. Yuno can’t hide is astonishment at how powerful the devil is as he tries to fight it, and then Asta and Mimosa also arrive!

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Natural Enemy
Episodes.Description: “When the owner of the four-leaf grimoire is filled with despair, the five-leaf clover grimoire will be born.” Patry is filled with despair after learning he had been manipulated by the devil all this time and turns into a dark elf. He then starts attacking Yuno and Asta, fueled by nothing but hatred and malice. Somehow, becoming a dark elf had made Patry even stronger, which gives Yuno and Asta an even harder time fighting him. Then Captain Nozel appears before them. Nozel happens to have the best magical attribute to fight against light magic, mercury magic.

Episodes.Title: Breaking the Seal
Episodes.Description: The strange little black bird Nero, who kept following Asta around, suddenly appears before Finral, who had just finished fighting with his brother Langris, and demands that he take them to the Demon’s bones back in Hage Village. Finral is obviously startled that Nero’s suddenly speaking human words but obliges and takes Nero to the bones and witnesses an unbelievable sight. We will finally find out the true events that befell the elves 500 years ago! Meanwhile, back at the Shadow Palace, the devil’s eerie magic fills the room.

Episodes.Title: A Reunion Across Time and Space
Episodes.Description: To stop the devil from leaving the Shadow Palace Asta, Yuno, and Patry, who had just regained his senses, head to the top floor. Once they get there, they are greeted by the first Wizard King, Lumiere Silvamillion Clover and the one who serves him, Secré Swallowtail。Secré is the true form of the mysterious bird, Nero, and she is a mage that uses a rare magic called sealing magic. She uses her magic to break the seal on Licht, and they are able to witness the true leader of the elves, Licht, and his true powers. An epic battle begins so that Licht and Lumiere can get revenge against the devil.

Episodes.Title: The Final Attack
Episodes.Description: Licht and Lumiere fight against the devil using incredibly powerful magic. But the devil has incredible regeneration powers and quickly heals himself, making him difficult to defeat. Asta witnesses the two powerful mages fighting and tries to figure out if he can use his anti-magic in a more useful way. He’s able to use a new power, but it’s so powerful that he’s having a hard time controlling it. Meanwhile, Yuno also awakens to a new power… Asta and Yuno, who both aspire to be the future Wizard King, pull off an impressive attack in front of the first Wizard King!

Episodes.Title: Dawn
Episodes.Description: The Shadow Palace begins to shatter, but Asta and the others manage to escape. Meanwhile, the elves continued to attack the kingdom because they still didn’t know the truth. Asta is the only one who can undo the resurrection, but it won’t be easy to save all of them at once. Patry then frees Vangeance, who’s sleeping inside him, so he can use his world tree magic and Licht can use his magic that connects him with all of the elves and Asta is able to undo the resurrection of all the elves at once. Finally, the long battle is coming to an end.

Episodes.Title: Three Problems
Episodes.Description: The battle involving the whole Clover Kingdom is finally over. But because of the battle, the kingdom was heavily damaged, so the Magic Knights were busy trying to repair everything. Meanwhile, someone rather unexpected shows up in front of Asta and the others and states three problems that will come up for the Clover Kingdom. Asta and the others are surprised, but just as they were told, someone showed up to try to judge Asta and his devil power.

Episodes.Title: As Pitch Black as It Gets
Episodes.Description: Asta, who has the power of the devil, and Secré who used forbidden magic and turned into Nero, were called before the Magical Parliament to be judged. Asta maintains his innocence, but Damnatio Kira will do everything he can to probe that Asta is guilty. In order to save Asta and Secré, Yami shows up with the Black Bulls and they cause a ruckus. While the Black Bulls cause trouble, a few others show up…

Episodes.Title: Nero Reminiscences… (1)
Episodes.Description: Because she used forbidden magic, Nero survived for centuries. In the back of her mind, memories from long ago start to replay in her head. From when Nero was still called Secré and when Secré first met the most powerful and talented mage in the Clover Kingdom, Prince Lumiere. They become friends with Licht and the other elves, but due to the evil plans of a devil, the humans end up killing all of Licht’s comrades. Because of that, Licht ends up turning into a demon and Lumiere finds him in that state. What will he have to do to protect the ones he loves?

Episodes.Title: Nero Reminiscences… (2)
Episodes.Description: After using forbidden magic in the fight against the devil, Secré turns into a bird and ends up spending centuries all alone. During that time, she ends up meeting Asta, who ends up with Licht’s grimoire that has a different devil residing in it. Patry ends up reviving due to resurrection magic, and then he becomes the leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun and vows to get revenge. This was all according to the devil’s plan and Secré uses her sealing magic to free Lumiere and Licht so they can finish off the devil once and for all along with Asta. The battle comes to an end, and Secré now begins her new life as a member of the Black Bulls.

Episodes.Title: Return
Episodes.Description: The Black Bulls return to where their base originally was. Henry has to return the Raging Bull back into their hideout, but apparently, that takes some time. Meanwhile, Yami tells the Black Bulls to go find the magical beasts that escaped from the hideout. They had run away when Rades and the others had attacked the hideout and had been wandering around the forest ever since. There was even a chance that they had returned to their feral states. Their fear comes true, as one Black Bull is attacked after another.

Episodes.Title: The Blue Rose’s Confession
Episodes.Description: The Black Bulls were ordered by the Wizard King to investigate the devils. Yami takes Asta and Nero and goes to talk to Captain Charlotte of the Blue Rose Knights, since she has experience with forbidden magic and curses. But when they get there, Charlotte suddenly runs off somewhere and they’re all in shock. Charlotte had memories of while Charla took over her body and fears that Yami had found out her true feelings and she ended up panicking. But then, she makes a decision.

Episodes.Title: Clues
Episodes.Description: In order to find out more about the forbidden curse, Asta, Gordon, Grey, and Gauche head to Gordon’s house, since he comes from a family of famous curse mages. Once they get there, they can’t help but show their wariness towards Gordon’s family. But in the end, they end up finding out valuable information while they’re there. Meanwhile, Noelle goes to talk to the Dorothy Unsworth, the Captain of the Coral Peacocks, after her brother tells her to talk to her to find out the truth behind their mother’s death. Dorothy tells her the name of the devil who had killed her mother, and the same name is spoken by Gordon’s grandmother. That devil’s name is…

Episodes.Title: To the Heart Kingdom!
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Gordon’s father, Asta and the others were able to find out that there might be clues surrounding the devils in the Heart Kingdom and manage to get permission to enter the kingdom due to the fact that Mimosa had gone there previously to study overbroad. Asta, Noelle, Finral, Mimosa and Nero head to the Heart Kingdom. Asta and the others initially enjoy their trip there, but something that Langris told Finral had been bugging Finral. Suddenly, Asta and the others are faced with a rather unexpected trial. Will Asta and the other Black Bulls be able to obtain information on the devils?!

Episodes.Title: The Devil Megicula
Episodes.Description: Asta and the others manage to meet with the queen of the Heart Kingdom, Loropechika, who had also been chosen by the water spirit, Undine. They are able to confirm that the devil’s curse that they spotted in the Heart Kingdom was originating from Loropechika herself and that the devil was in the Spade Kingdom. Meanwhile, Vanessa, Magna, and Luck went to investigate the Diamond Kingdom and find it in ruins after a single mage of the Spade Kingdom had annihilated them. In order to defeat this devil, Loropechika asks Asta and the others for their help…

Episodes.Title: The New Magic Knights Captain Conference
Episodes.Description: The Magic Knight Squad Captains decide to have a meeting about the problem with the devils that ended up involving the whole Clover Kingdom. Asta and the others who were in the Heart Kingdom were also summoned and they disclose the information they gathered in front of Julius, Damnatio, and the Captains. After hearing what Asta and the others had to report, Julius tells everyone what they need to do in order to deal with the devil Megicula.

Episodes.Title: A New Resolve
Episodes.Description: Asta and Yuno are given permission to go home to Hage for a little while. Asta was being called a devil in the papers, but Father, Sister Lily, everyone at the church, as well as the people who even used to make fun of Asta and Yuno because they were orphans, welcomed them home with open arms. Asta and Yuno see that they had gone down the right path and all their hard work wasn’t for nothing, and then…

Episodes.Title: The Lion Awakens
Episodes.Description: The Black Bulls get a sudden visit from Mereleona and she drags them to the strong magic region of the Yultim Volcano. There, the Crimson Lion Kings, as well as their captain, Fuegoleon, and his younger brother Leopold, were waiting for them. Asta and Noelle remember the hot springs they had visited on their previous trip there. Finding new resolve, Magna, Luck, Charmy, Gordon, and Nero all decide to train in the fiery underground cave of the volcano!

Episodes.Title: The Lion Awakens, Continued
Episodes.Description: As Asta and the others were chasing the creature that lived in the cave beneath the Yultim Volcano Trail, they happened upon a dungeon. They were then ordered to explore the dungeon by the royal capital, so they split into groups and went in. They head in with Leopold and Vice Captain Randall, but those two end up running into the creature from earlier. They work together but cannot defeat the monster, which makes Leopold feel useless. At that moment, Leopold remembers the strange feeling he felt when he was fighting the elves, and…

Episodes.Title: Those Who Have Been Gathered
Episodes.Description: Asta and Noelle return to the Black Bulls’ hideout only to get taken away by Mereoleona again. The place they were brought this time was the Vermillion estate. Waiting for them there was Captain Fuegoleon, Kirsch, Mimosa, and the sister who looked after the children at the church in Nean, Sister Theresa, who was also known as the former Magic Knight, the Crimson She-Leopard. Asta and Noelle wait in anticipation, wondering if they are going to get a new mission, but what Fuegoleon actually tells them is…

Episodes.Title: The One Who Has My Heart, My Mind, and Soul
Episodes.Description: Though their betrothal was decided between their families, Finral tries to become a better man for Finnes’ sake. However, his impulse to instantly hit on any girl he happens to see doesn’t seem to get better, so he asks Asta to help him train… But they end up going to a mixer. Meanwhile, the members of the Blue Rose Knights want to help Charlotte out with her chances at love and invite Yami to a mixer-like setting at the same pub. What will result from both of these mixers?

Episodes.Title: A Black Deep Sea Story
Episodes.Description: Noelle and the other Black Bulls head to Racquey to do some training, when Noelle hears a mysterious voice. Shortly after, the Black Bulls are reunited with Kahono and Kiato. The siblings ask them for help and they head down to the Underwater Temple. There, Gifso explains that a creature called the guardian has gone berserk, so in order to quell its rage, Kahono and Kiato need to present it with their song and dance. Gifso asks the Black Bulls to act as their bodyguards and Yami appoints Noelle and Finral for the job.

Episodes.Title: Charmy’s Century of Hunger, Gordon’s Millennium of Loneliness
Episodes.Description: Asta and the other Black Bulls continue their training in order to face off with the devil. Charmy is trying to use her cotton magic and her Sheep Cooks to create food to enhance her friends’ mana, but she realizes she lacks training. She then decides to seek out someone who can help her. Meanwhile, Gordon is also unhappy with his inability to help his friends, so he decides to go off to train on his own.

Episodes.Title: In Zara’s Footsteps
Episodes.Description: Zora wanders off from the rest of the Black Bulls and heads back home to his village to visit his father’s grave. He then meets a boy from his village named Ina. Ina idolizes Zara who became the first peasant to become a Magic Knight and was training hard in hopes to be like him someday. But then, Ina is confronted by a noble boy named Kaito, who was visiting the village on vacation, and is told that his dreams are futile. Enraged, Ina tries to fight Kaito, but Zora stops him. Zora then tells Ina a little story.

Episodes.Title: A Witch’s Homecoming
Episodes.Description: Vanessa Enoteca returns to the Witches’ Forest and requests that the Witch Queen teach her ancient magic. In exchange, the Queen tasks Vanessa with training two witches, Samantha Kravitz and Elvira Aguirre, and resolving an issue with the forest’s defenses in case of an attack from the Spade Kingdom.

Episodes.Title: A Favor for Julius
Episodes.Description: Julius asks Marx to do a favor for him. He wanted him to help with creating new magic items as well as take care of some bandits. Marx is accompanied by the former member of the Eye of the Midnight Sun, Sally, to the Black Bulls’ hideout in order to conduct experiments for magic item research. Next, he travels with Captain Fuegoleon and Captain Nozel to investigate the bandits. Apparently, Julius had visited even that faraway town in disguise before…

Episodes.Title: The Golden Family
Episodes.Description: The Golden Dawn was hard at work trying to get the kingdom back onto its feet. They were trying to make amends for the trouble they had caused while they were possessed. Captain Vangeance puts Alecdora Sandler in charge of a mission. Alecdora can’t hide his dislike for Yuno so he tries his best to earn more merit than him.

Episodes.Title: Those Remaining
Episodes.Description: While the Clover Kingdom was trying to get back onto its feet, the citizens learn that the one behind the destruction of their homes is called the devil, and many of them grew to hate the devil. Some of these people had gathered and created a group called the Devil Banishers. Because the Magic Parliament did not immediately punish the supposed servants of the devil, they decide to go after Asta and Nero and take matters into their own hands.

Episodes.Title: The Tilted Scale
Episodes.Description: After being attacked by the Devil Banishers, Nero as well as Gauche’s younger sister, Marie, were kidnapped and Asta fell into a mysterious coma. Gauche thinks that maybe the head of the Magic Parliament, Damnatio, may have taken his sister, but Damnatio denies the claim. Damnatio’s innocence is proven by using Marx’s communication magic, but they learn that there’s a possibility that Damnatio’s subordinates are behind this incident. Meanwhile, Asta was taken to Owen’s clinic and it becomes apparent that the tracking device he had on his arm had disappeared. They then find its signal coming from somewhere rather unexpected.

Episodes.Title: Those Who Wish for the Devil’s Demise
Episodes.Description: Julius orders the Black Bulls to save Nero and Marie, so Captain Yami, Noelle, Finral, Gordon and Gauche travel to a certain town along with the captain of the Silver Eagles Nozel, to see if they can find any clues. They try to ask the townspeople for some clues, but it appears that they are less than willing to cooperate because they seem to hold a grudge against the Magic Knights who weren’t able to come to their immediate aid after they were attacked by the elves.

Episodes.Title: Rescue
Episodes.Description: The Devil Banishers announce that they will judge Nero and Marie in public. Julius then orders the Black Bulls and other Magic Knights to go rescue them. The Magic Knights place themselves among a crowd that clearly hates the devil, and then the Devil Banishers appear. They then demand that the devil-possessed Asta show himself.

Episodes.Title: Those Who Worship the Devil
Episodes.Description: Though the Magic Knights were able to save Marie from the Devil Banishers, Nero is taken once again and Asta’s 5-leaf clover grimoire is also stolen. Suddenly, they receive a message from one of Damnatio’s subordinates and learn the true identities of the Devil Banishers and Julius orders the Black Bulls yet again to save Nero. The Black Bulls begin their investigation in the town where they think the Devil Banishers were gathering. Will they be able to find out what the enemy’s true motive?

Episodes.Title: Prepared to Die
Episodes.Description: Asta, Noelle, and Magna manage to catch up to the Devil Believers who had taken Nero. But they find that the Devil Believers have now grown in numbers. Magna goes back to tell Yami of the situation. Asta and Noelle are left behind and try to do what they can to save Nero. But it appears that the Devil Believers have made up their minds on achieving their goal, even if it costs them their lives.

Episodes.Title: Becoming the Light That Shines Through the Darkness
Episodes.Description: Asta and Noelle are captured along with Nero and they head toward the strong magic region near the border when Captain Yami and Magna arrive. Captain Fuegoleon and Captain Nozel also show up, causing the Devil Believers to panic. The captains try to talk to the Devil Believers, but their distrust for them is just too strong. The Devil Believers try to bring their powers together in order to face the Magic Knight captains.

Episodes.Title: Two Things to Look for
Episodes.Description: The incident with the Devil Believers had come to a close. This whole incident ends up hurting Nero, who witnessed the pain the Devil Believers felt from having less mana and reminds her of her time with the first Wizard King, Lumiere and the magic item he was trying to create to get rid of discrimination in their kingdom. She then gets summoned by Julius. Meanwhile, Asta and the others receive a message saying that the Heart Kingdom and the Spirit Guardians were ready to train them for their fight against the devil.

Episodes.Title: The Maidens’ Challenge
Episodes.Description: To prepare for the upcoming battle against the devil, the Black Bull Grey decided that she needed to get over her shyness and be able to face her friends first before anything else, so she asked Noelle to mentor her. However, things aren’t going very well. Next, Grey tries to get Gauche to help her, since they had fought together in the past. For this training, she walked around town with him when it was crowded, but then they saw a panicked Charlotte run by.

Episodes.Title: Clash! The Battle of the Magic Knights Squad Captains
Episodes.Description: The Magic Knight Squad Captains end up doing a team battle due to Julius’ suggestion. Since the citizens are still weary after the attack by the Eye of the Midnight Sun, they want to prove that they still mean to protect the kingdom and its citizens. The Magic Knights watch in anticipation as their captains split up into two teams and go all out in this battle.

Episodes.Title: To Tomorrow!
Episodes.Description: Asta and Noelle go to see the Magic Knight Entrance Exams with Yami. The testing site and the anti-birds that gather there are rather nostalgic to Asta and remembers his own experience at the exams last year after seeing the hopefuls from this year.

Episodes.Title: The Chosen Ones
Episodes.Description: The Magic Knight Squad Captains gather for a meeting and for an award ceremony with the king later. At the meeting, they decide that Asta, Nero, Noelle, Luck, Finral, Mimosa, Leopold, Charlotte and Rill will be going to the Heart Kingdom to train with the Spirit Guardians. At the award ceremony, Yuno advances very quickly in rank.

Episodes.Title: Vice Captain Langris Vaude
Episodes.Description: Though Vangeance, the Captain of the Golden Dawn, had asked Langris to return to his duties as vice captain, he continues to distance himself from the squad. Yuno had suddenly moved up all the ranks at a decoration ceremony and Langris asks him to fight him. The rest of the squad seems shocked, but Yuno accepts Langris’ request and fights him and they have a fierce battle. But during their fight, Yuno seems to have some doubts with how Langris is fighting.

Episodes.Title: The 5 Spirit Guardians
Episodes.Description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at the same church and have been inseparable since. As children, they promised that they would compete against each other to see who would become the next Emperor Magus. However, as they grew up, some differences between them became plain. Yuno was a genius with magic, with amazing power and control, while Asta could not use magic at all, and tried to make up for his lack by training physically. When they received their Grimoires at age 15, Yuno got a spectacular book with a four-leaf clover (most people receive a three-leaf-clover), while Asta received nothing at all. However, when Yuno was threatened, the truth about Asta’s power was revealed, he received a five-leaf clover Grimoire, a “black clover”! Now the two friends are heading out in the world, both seeking the same goal!

Episodes.Title: Awakening Powers
Episodes.Description: While Asta and the others were training in the Heart Kingdom, back in the Clover Kingdom, Yami asked Mereoleona to help him train. They start their training immediately and Yami is no match against Mereoleona who is a master at using Mana Zone. Meanwhile, the Spade Kingdom’s forces continues to draw nearer as it continues its invasion.

Episodes.Title: Five-Leaf Clover
Episodes.Description: Months after arriving at the Heart Kingdom, Asta still doesn’t have any magic, but he’s become more powerful at an alarming speed due to his training with the Spirit Guardians. Anti-magic is one of the magic attributes that falls into the “Arcane Stage” and is needed to defeat the devil. And because of that, Gaja asks Asta how exactly he obtained the five-leaf grimoire.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of Hope and Despair
Episodes.Description: The Spade Kingdom successfully takes over the Diamond Kingdom and then sets their sights on the Clover Kingdom and Heart Kingdom. The Spade Kingdom troops get through the strong magic region using a mobile fortress which sucks up the mana of the Spade Kingdom citizens who were taken by force. But then Asta, who had finished his training with the Spirit Guardians, comes to the rescue! Meanwhile, Luck and Leopold head to the Spade Kingdom in order to try to take over one of their bases.

Episodes.Title: Quiet Lakes and Forest Shadows
Episodes.Description: For some reason, Charmy, who had tagged along with Asta and the others to train in the Heart Kingdom, keeps trying to eat up all of the food in the Heart Kingdom. Asta tries to take her back and goes to the forest Charmy is last seen. However, Charmy had also trained with the Spirit Guardians and had become even more powerful. Meanwhile, Yuno is contacted by Sister Lily and heads back to his home village of Hage.

Episodes.Title: The Messenger from the Spade Kingdom
Episodes.Description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned in front of the church in Hage Village, a village in the outskirts of the Clover Kingdom. And now, we finally find out the truth behind Yuno’s birth! Meanwhile, while Vice Captain Yuno was away, the Golden Dawn’s headquarters was attacked by the Spade Kingdom. Despite being the most powerful squad out of the Magic Knights, they might have finally met their match.

Episodes.Title: Zenon’s Power
Episodes.Description: After hearing about the Golden Dawn members being in trouble, Yuno hurries back. When he returned, their headquarters had been destroyed and many of the squad members were near death. Yuno’s rage explodes. Meanwhile, the members who can still fight are doing their best to hold up against the attackers that includes one of the members of the Dark Triade, Zenon, and his minions.

Episodes.Title: The Great War Breaks Out
Episodes.Description: The War against the Spade Kingdom begins in earnest as the Heart Kingdom and Black Bulls come under attack by Dante and Vanica of the Dark Triad.

Episodes.Title: Dante vs. the Captain of the Black Bulls
Episodes.Description: Grey reminisces on her past. Meanwhile the fight between Dante and Asta is continuing!

Episodes.Title: Battlefield: Heart Kingdom
Episodes.Description: Yami strikes Dante what should have been a mortal blow, but he recovers quickly with the Power of his Devil. Asta witnesses his own Devil seethe in frenzy. In the Heart Kingdom, Charmy and Leo battle more Dark Disciples.

Episodes.Title: Water Crusade
Episodes.Description: Vanica has arrived to kill the Queen of the Heart Kingdom and revealed their plan to unleash an army of demons into the world. Thanks to Megicula’s curse magic Vanica has restored to full strength all the Dark Disciples everyone had fought so hard to defeat. But Noelle, Mimosa, and Nero will push past their limits and show the results of their long training; For Aceir Silva, for the world, and for their precious friend, Lolopechka.

Episodes.Title: Captain: Yami Sukehiro
Episodes.Description: As the situation in the Heart Kingdom deteriorates beyond belief,  Captain Yami Sukehiro pushes past his limits.

Episodes.Title: Black Oath
Episodes.Description: As the battles in the Heart Kingdom begin to come to an end, Asta and Yami decide to work together as they continue in their fight against Dante Zogratis of the Dark Triad.

Episodes.Title: Stirrings of the Strongest
Episodes.Description: Yami and Vangeance are taken to the Spade Kingdom so that the ritual to open the gate to the underworld can begin. Despite how hurt he is, Asta tries to escape the infirmary to go and save Yami, however he is stopped by a mage named Nacht Faust, who also happens to be a devil-possessed. He offers to show Asta how to use his devil powers even better. Meanwhile, the Magic Knight Squad Captains hold an emergency meeting. The Golden Dawn has almost been completely annihilated, and Yuno shows up to the meeting, showing new resolve.

Episodes.Title: The Devil-Binding Ritual
Episodes.Description: Noelle and the others were involved in the explosion that Vanica caused back in the Heart Kingdom and were left unconscious. When they woke up, they found themselves in the new home of the elves that was located in a strong magic region just beyond the Heart Kingdom. There, Noelle has an unexpected reunion.

Episodes.Title: The Faraway Future
Episodes.Description: Due to Nacht's spell, the Devil who has been granting Asta power since the beginning has appeared physically. To master his Devil powers, Asta must battle and defeat his Devil, and force him to submit. But Asta has other plans... Meanwhile, Yuno, Noelle, and the others grow stronger in order to take their revenge against the Dark Triad.

Entries.Title: Fireworks of My Heart
Entries.Description: Fire chief Song Yan and emergency doctor Xu Qin were separated by family opposition when they were younger. Now ten years later, they meet again due to their professions. After experiencing life and death together, they manage to find their way back, working together and encouraging each other. They acknowledge each other's individual growth after years apart, but will they be able to overcome the obstacles in their path this time to stay together?

Episodes.Title: Long Time No See
Episodes.Description: The Shili Tai Fire and Rescue Station is in a festive scene. Suddenly the alarm rang, and firefighters were dispatched immediately. In the early morning, ER doctor Xu Qin had just returned from the emergency room after a major operation. A few firefighters covered in mud rushed in, begging her to treat his comrade who has a toothache. When she told the man to remove his mask, the man turned away and left the emergency room.

Episodes.Title: Under The Same Roof
Episodes.Description: Song Yan was called to the Captain's Office. The team received complaints. Thanks to the persuasion from the staff officer, Song Yan got out of the siege. In the locker room, several colleagues were talking about Xu Qin, and it was rumored that she was the next person to be promoted. It was said that Xu Qin's family had an unusual background, and her colleagues were stunned. Xu Qin encountered a traffic accident on the way off from work, Xu Qin stopped immediately and prepared to enter the scene.

Episodes.Title: Revival
Episodes.Description: Song Yan came back from a mission and couldn't find the lighter, he ran to the garbage station to look for it. Song Yan told Suo Jun that the two had broken up due to family issues. Suo Jun comforted him. Xu Qin and Meng Yanchen came to the bar opened by Xiao Yixiao. After hearing that the fire department came to do a fire inspection, Xu Qin thought she could see Song Yan and ran out immediately. Seeing that Song Yan was not the one who came to check, Xu Qin felt depressed.

Episodes.Title: I Still Have You in My Heart
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin learned that Song Yan was on vacation. So she came to his aunt's house again, hoping to reconcile with him. Song Yan refused. In the fire station, Song Yan complained to Suo Jun about the poor performance of the recruits. Song Yan firmly believed that he and Suo Jun could turn Shili Tai into the best fire station in the country. Suo Jun dodged his eyes.

Episodes.Title: Risk of Infection
Episodes.Description: The driver who caused the accident surived, but the HIV-positive result of the blood test made everyone break out in a cold sweat. Not only were the doctors and nurses involved in the rescue at risk of infection, but the firefighters involved in the rescue that day were more likely to be infected. Xu Qin called the fire station, and all firefighters who participated in the rescue and were injured had to be checked. Xu Qin was worried and drew blood for Song Yan.

Episodes.Title: Home Accident
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin was awakened by knocking on the door. It turned out a child's hand was stuck in the anti-theft fence of the balcony upstairs. Song Yan led the firefighters to launch a rescue from the balcony of Xu Qin's house. The child was saved. After the firefighters completed their task and extracted, Song Yan turned back, which surprised Xu Qin.

Episodes.Title: Stayed The Same
Episodes.Description: Song Yan mistakenly thought it was his younger sister who came to bring him clothes and went out immediately. When the other firefighters heard that it was the female doctor Song Yan knows, they couldn't help but hide behind and peek. Xu Qin asked Song Yan to invite her to dinner, Song Yan reluctantly agreed. The two prepared for the date and came to a fried chicken shop they used to visit in high school. Time brings the two back to ten years ago.

Episodes.Title: My Closest Comrade
Episodes.Description: Suo Jun told Song Yan about his difficulty, and Song Yan finally understood why Suo Jun wanted to be transferred. Suo Jun also advised Song Yan to get married soon. The two settled their suspicions. Looking at the honors of the fire station and listened to the thanks of the girl he saved, he tore up the transfer application he had written.

Episodes.Title: Warning
Episodes.Description: Fu Wenying learns that Xu Qin doesn’t go on a date because of her busy work, and needs her to change her job. Xu Qin confesses that she has someone she likes. Fu Wenying warns Xu Qin not to force herself to be a villain again.

Episodes.Title: Back to The Square One
Episodes.Description: Due to her mother's strict discipline, Xu Qin hasn’t dared to disobey her mother since she was a child. Although she is independent now, she is still stressed and afraid of facing her mother. She asks Song Yan to come out. Song Yan already knows she is in a dilemma before she speaks. Therefore, Song Yan agrees to go back to  square one.

Episodes.Title: Tamed Beast
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin speaks her mind to Meng Yanchen. She thinks she has been like a tame beast since she was a kid so she didn't dare to resist her mother and also doesn’t know what love is. Meng Yanchen proposes to her to go abroad with him but she refuses.

Episodes.Title: Meaningless Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: In order to speed up the replacement of old teammates and new blood, Jiang Yu proposes an idea to Song Yan but he disagrees with him. Song Yan thinks a fire scene is extremely dangerous and the new blood don’t have enough experience so they only are the reserves. Jiang Yu just wishes to avoid more meaningless sacrifices between the firefighters.

Episodes.Title: You're Not Her Brother
Episodes.Description: Meng Yanchen finds Xu Qin in the hospital, and he meets Song Yan by chance. He warns Song Yan to keep his distance from Xu Qin. Song Yan understands what he means and tells him not to interfere with Xu Qin’s life since he is not her biological brother. Meng Yanchen advises her not to end the relationship with her family because of Song Yan.

Episodes.Title: A Blind Date
Episodes.Description: Since Xu Qin is reluctant to go on the blind date arranged by her mother, she arranges for the parents of both parties to meet. Xu Qin tells Jiang Yu that she has a crush on a man. He promises to help her.

Episodes.Title: A Thankless Job
Episodes.Description: A few college backpackers are stuck in a mountain and needed rescuing. Even the local civilian rescue team goes missing after looking for them. Without knowing the exact location, the firefighters face a tough rescue with the weather conditions and terrain. Meanwhile, Xu Qin receives a lesson on reading patients, not just treating them.

Episodes.Title: Setting Up a Joint Rescue Team
Episodes.Description: Shilitai Fire and Rescue Station proposes a joint rescue effort with the city's First People's Hospital. Xu Qin volunteers to join the training. At the fire station, both firefighters and medical staff learn from one another to improve the efficiency and efficacy of rescue operations.

Episodes.Title: Duality
Episodes.Description: After a bus flips over, a passenger named Chen Yu rescues many people before the firefighters arrive, but he is thrown out of the bus when it falls off a cliff and is seriously injured. He is called a hero by everyone, but he has an unknown side to him. Meanwhile, after the rescue, reporters want to interview Song Yan, but he introduces Xu Qin as the rescue team leader and gives the opportunity to her instead.

Episodes.Title: Dignity
Episodes.Description: Jiang Yu and Li Meng went to a fire scene for a second inspection, but found some problems. The person in charge of the warehouse called a group of hooligans to beat them up but the firefighters can't fight or talk back, so they felt down in the dumps. Song Yan figured out a way to resolve their grievances, and they trained even harder.

Episodes.Title: Gifts
Episodes.Description: Wu Xuan Yang calls 119 to rescue him and his alpaca, but Dr. Xu discovers that he has a serious condition called aortic dissection. His family doubts Dr. Xu's diagnosis but ends up being thankful to her for saving him. Meanwhile, Song Yan and Xu Qin exchange gifts with one another.

Episodes.Title: Mission
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin's mom discovers about Xu Qin staying the fire station. She goes to Song Yan to tell him to stop seeing Xu Qin. However, Xu Qin tries to rekindle with Song Yan who shuts her down in return. Later, they get into an argument about the mission of public servants.

Episodes.Title: Drill
Episodes.Description: With the medical staff gone from the fire station, Song Yan misses Xu Qin even though he refuses to admit it. However, a fire drill at the hospital reunites them again. Meanwhile, Dr. Xu contemplates her profession.

Episodes.Title: Rescue Team
Episodes.Description: Teams are organized to help with the disaster rescue of earthquake victims in Wangxiang. The place is in bad shape, with many collapsed houses and structures and missing people. That includes Jiang Yi's mom, who's in Wangxiang with her sister, Jiang Yi's aunt.

Episodes.Title: Missing
Episodes.Description: Meng Yan Chen's mom wants her son and husband to let people know about the help they've been giving to disaster relief. Meanwhile, Song Yan and Xu Qin are both exhausted from the disaster rescue. Then, Song Yan gets seriously injured.

Episodes.Title: Duty
Episodes.Description: Despite knowing Song Yan's life is in danger, Xu Qin chooses not to stay by his side and continues fulfilling her duty as a doctor. The firefighters continue doing their mission in earthquake relief. Later, Xu Qin and Jiang Yi receive news that put their mind at ease.

Episodes.Title: Falling into Place
Episodes.Description: After the successful disaster relief operation, Song Yan and Xu Qin go back to their lives. However, they can't continue setting aside their feelings for each other anymore. Things are beginning to fall into place, even in Dr. Xu's work.

Episodes.Title: Overcoming Trauma
Episodes.Description: Some firefighters struggle to get over their traumatic experience after providing the disaster relief at Wangxiang and are forced to overcome their anxiety by Yang Chi. Xu Qin is annoyed that Song Yan doesn't contact her for a day and doubts their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Caterpillars
Episodes.Description: Meng Yan Chen finds out that Song Yan and Xu Qin are back together and tries to discourage Song Yan from being with her. He feels like he's been abandoned since Xu Qin went to find her happiness. Meanwhile, Xu Qin has learned to appreciate the process even if there might be no good outcome.

Episodes.Title: Staying Together
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin confesses to her parents that she is dating Song Yan who highly disapprove of their relationship. As a result, she moves out from home into Song Yan's. His aunt and uncle welcome her happily.

Episodes.Title: Progress
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin is welcomed warmly in the home of Song Yan's uncle and aunt. Xu Qin wants Meng Yan Chen to speak to their mom for her, but he refuses. Meanwhile, things seem to be progressing between Meng Yan Chen and Ye Zi.

Episodes.Title: Assurance
Episodes.Description: Yan Chen tries to persuade his mom to let Xu Qin live her life, btu she doesn't back down. She invites Xu Qin to go shopping with her as a pretense to introduce her to another guy. Later, a mother and son threatens to jump off the hospital building Xu Qin works at.

Episodes.Title: Danger
Episodes.Description: There's a cyanide leak at an electroplating plant. Firefighters are dispatched to save the three workers who have been poisoned and resolve the issue. However, Song Yan also gets poisoned during the process.

Episodes.Title: New Year
Episodes.Description: Song Yan tells Xu Qin his future plans for them. Everyone is busy preparing and celebrating New Year, but the firefighters are still on duty to protect people. Xu Qin also goes home to visit her family for New Year.

Episodes.Title: Flashover
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin is having a difficult time because her mom is interfering with her work at the hospital. Meanwhile, Song Yan is preparing for his transfer. However, a huge fire breaks out with a flashover that endangers the firefighters' lives.

Episodes.Title: Making Choices
Episodes.Description: A life is lost in the fire at Junguang Square, which is owned by Guokun Group. Song Yan has to decide whether to report about the truth of the fire which caused a death of his comrade. However, that decision will sow more discord between him and Xu Qin's family.

Episodes.Title: New Developments
Episodes.Description: Song Yan is being suspended from work due to accusations of bribery. A new development in Shilitai Fire and Rescue Station also makes Song Yan's decision to transfer waver. And Xu Qin starts asking for explanations of things that happened in the past.

Episodes.Title: Gunshot Truth
Episodes.Description: A patient at the hospital gets worked up and injures Xu Qin's wrist. Meanwhile, despite being in an argument over his past, Song Yan still does not want to tell Xu Qin how he got his gunshot wound. Zhai Miao is worried for him and goes to see Xu Qin to help patch up their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Accusations
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin finds out what her family did to Song Yan and confronts her parents. Meanwhile, Meng Yan Chen frankly tells Ye Zi his thoughts about her and makes her angry. So she comes up with a plan to take revenge on him.

Episodes.Title: An Eye for an Eye
Episodes.Description: Zhai Miao holds the evidence to prove Yan Chen's innocence. The choice is in her hands whether to give it up and help the Meng family that ruined Song Yan's life, or do the same and destroy the Meng family.

Episodes.Title: Typhoon
Episodes.Description: Song Yan and Xu Qin are busy working with little time to prepare for their wedding. Meanwhile, a super typhoon makes landfall in Yancheng and causes many people to be trapped or injured. Both the firefighters and medical staff have their hands full to help the people of Yancheng.

Episodes.Title: The Reaching Hand
Episodes.Description: A typhoon causes disasters in the city. Floods and fallen trees slow down Xu Qin and Song Yan from rescuing civilians. At this moment, Mrs. Meng is trapped in her car under a collapsing tunnel. Will rescuers get to her in time?

Entries.Title: Descendants of the Sun
Entries.Description: After a chance meeting in a hospital, an ardent soldier falls for a gifted surgeon. Opposing philosophies tear them apart, but fate has other plans.

Episodes.Title: Will You Be My Doctor?
Episodes.Description: While on vacation after a sensitive military operation, soldier Si-jin senses a connection with Mo-yeon, a beautiful and strong-willed surgeon.

Episodes.Title: We Bump Into Each Other While Passing By
Episodes.Description: Si-jin and Dae-young engage in a perilous operation in Afghanistan, while Mo-yeon assists in surgery. Later, Si-jin and Mo-yeon take in a movie.

Episodes.Title: How Have You Been?
Episodes.Description: Si-jin and Alpha Team join Mo-yeon and the doctors in Urk. Meanwhile, Myung-ju doesn't like how her father, Lt. Gen. Yoon, treats Dae-young.

Episodes.Title: I Will Find a Way to Drink
Episodes.Description: Tempers flare over a dying man when Mo-yeon insists she can save the patient's life. Meanwhile, Dae-young and Myung-ju reunite at the airport.

Episodes.Title: What Should I Do About the Kiss
Episodes.Description: After sharing a moment, Mo-yeon isn't sure what to think about her relationship with Si-jin. Later, Si-jin receives a panicked phone call.

Episodes.Title: I Shouldn't Have Received His Apology
Episodes.Description: After a powerful earthquake strikes Urk, the country descends into chaos. It's up to the medical team and soldiers to search for survivors.

Episodes.Title: I Missed You
Episodes.Description: In the earthquake's aftermath, heartbreaking decisions must be made by Si-jin and Mo-yeon, who both strive to save as many people as possible.

Episodes.Title: Comfort the Deceased With a Silent Prayer
Episodes.Description: When an aftershock strikes, Mo-yeon sees firsthand just how dangerous Si-jin's job can be. Later, an old phone message is accidentally broadcast.

Episodes.Title: That Wasn't Me
Episodes.Description: Mo-yeon is embarrassed after her unintentional confession, but Si-jin isn't about to let her off the hook. Meanwhile, a visitor makes everyone nervous.

Episodes.Title: You Got a Parcel From Shin Ji Young
Episodes.Description: Dae-young is rattled after seeing an old nemesis, Mo-yeon shares a dark dinner with Si-jin, and an unusual package arrives from home.

Episodes.Title: Who on Earth Stole It?
Episodes.Description: While Dae-young and Myung-ju remain quarantined, the rest of the team fights the epidemic. Meanwhile, the supply truck with the cure disappears.

Episodes.Title: As of This Moment, Everyone Will Return to Team Alpha
Episodes.Description: Dae-young has a bad feeling about Si-jin's solo mission into Argus's hideout. Mo-yeon wonders if she's capable of dealing with Si-jin's secrecy.

Episodes.Title: You're Not My Director Any More
Episodes.Description: The medical team returns to their regular lives, but something's off. Meanwhile, Mo-yeon makes a bold career move, and Dae-young faces a tough choice.

Episodes.Title: The Movie We Missed
Episodes.Description: After a patient is rushed to the hospital, Mo-yeon is shocked to see who is in need of care. Meanwhile, a microchip reveals unexpected information.

Episodes.Title: I Will Stay Alive
Episodes.Description: Si-jin and Mo-yeon spend some much deserved time together. Dae-young and Myung-ju continue to have communication problems. Devastating news arrives.

Episodes.Title: A Promise Made in the Dark
Episodes.Description: As the team faces a new threat, Si-jin and Mo-yeon's relationship is tested like never before. Meanwhile, secrets from the past come to light.

Episodes.Title: The Hardest Goodbye
Episodes.Description: A mission goes wrong, forcing everyone to make impossible choices. Dae-young and Myung-ju finally confront their feelings for each other.

Episodes.Title: When the Sun Sets
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of tragedy, the team must find a way to move forward. Si-jin makes a decision that will change everything.

Episodes.Title: The Soldier's Vow
Episodes.Description: As danger closes in, Si-jin and Mo-yeon fight to protect everything they love. A familiar face returns with shocking news.

Episodes.Title: This Is Unbelievable
Episodes.Description: Mo-yeon and Myung-ju learn that not everything is what it seems. Meanwhile, a promotion is cause for celebration, and a trip reignites old passions.

Entries.Title: Twinkling Watermelon
Entries.Description: A CODA (child of deaf adult) student born with a gift for music crash lands at an unfamiliar place after time traveling through a suspicious music shop. There, he forms the band Watermelon Sugar with other mysterious youths.

Episodes.Title: Passion Is Born
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol and his family move into a new neighborhood. He meets a man who offers to teach him how to play the guitar, and Eun-gyeol works hard to learn it. As he deals with bullies at school, he practices playing the guitar until he is as good as the man who taught him. However, tragedy strikes, and he and his family are forced to move again.

Episodes.Title: Eun-gyeol Quits Music
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol tries his best to quit music, but it's not easy for him to do. He gets scouted to join SPINE9, an indie band in Hongdae. To make things worse, he finally gets his hands on the guitar promised by the Viva Music store owner. He is torn by which path to take and finds himself walking into a suspicious music store.

Episodes.Title: Seoul 1995
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol gets stuck in 1995 and doesn't know how to return to the present. What's worse is that he meets his young father, Yi-chan, who can talk and wants to start a band to impress a girl who isn't Eun-gyeol's mother. Eun-gyeol poses as Yoon Dong-jin, a musical genius, in order to try to become a member of Yi-chan's band.

Episodes.Title: Eun-gyeol Becomes Yi-chan's Tutor
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol encounters Se-gyeong in her teens and learns a few things about her life that don't make sense in the future. Meanwhile, Yi-chan meets Chung-ah for the first time, but she doesn't say a word. Yi-chan tries to get away from Eun-gyeol, but Eun-gyeol follows him to the Snail Guesthouse and ends up becoming Yi-chan's math tutor.

Episodes.Title: Se-gyeong Leaves the Country
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol resolves to stop the accident that caused Yi-chan to become deaf and clings to him, vowing to teach him everything he needs to know. He even promises to gift him the band Yi-chan needs. However, the school festival is in one month, and the person Yi-chan is doing this for has left the country and isn't going to return.

Episodes.Title: Se-gyeong Returns
Episodes.Description: Everyone is confused at Se-gyeong's return, especially Eun-gyeol, who sternly warns her to stay away from Yi-chan. However, it doesn't work, and Se-gyeong approaches Yi-chan with different intentions. Meanwhile, Chung-ah can only stand by and watch as she realizes she's lost her chance to tell Yi-chan how she feels.

Episodes.Title: Where Are You Eun-gyeol?
Episodes.Description: Chung-ah wakes up, realizing she's lying on a hospital bed, with the revelation that Yi-chan carried her there on his back. Later, Yi-chan learns her name from her tag for the first time. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol has been silent for days, causing concern for Yi-chan. Attempting to locate him, Yi-chan hands out flyers and ends up facing trouble with local thugs. Se-gyeong desperately meets with each band member to verify something important.

Episodes.Title: I Found Ha Eun-gyeol
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol wakes up at the house of the Jinsung Family after the accident. He finds out that Chung-ah was the daughter of Chairman Yoon Gun-hyung. Meanwhile, Yi-chan is hospitalized after getting beat up by the local thugs. Se-gyeong tells him that Chung-ah was the one who called for help to save him. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol decides to help Chung-ah learn the sign language.

Episodes.Title: Friendship or Love?
Episodes.Description: Astounded by Eun-gyeol's candid love confession for Se-gyeong, Yi-chan retaliates with a spirited punch. Eun-gyeol's attempts at self-defense lead to Yi-chan having a bleeding nose on both sides. The schoolyard transforms into a battleground as students try to intervene, and the entire situation gains momentum. Se-gyeong (actually Eun-yu) is left in shock by the unexpected confession. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol uncovers a hidden secret about Chung-ah.

Episodes.Title: Let Yourself Twinkle
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol can't hide his feelings for Se-gyeong and ends up kissing her. Chung-ah's stepmother calls Eun-gyeol separately and tells him to quit before he teaches Chung-ah sign language. The members of the band decide to change their band name and theme right before the festival and ask Se-gyeong and Chung-ah for help. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol learns that Master has sent a helper for him.

Episodes.Title: Dangerous Rehearsal
Episodes.Description: As the festival draws near, the boys are intensely focused on fine-tuning their band performance. Meanwhile, Eun-gyeol reflects on a pivotal clue related to a potential accident leading to hearing loss. Believing Dong-jin to be the helper that Master mentioned, he pleads with Yi-chan to skip the rehearsal, but his request is dismissed. Meanwhile, Eun-yu grapples with the challenge of uncovering her mother's genuine first love.

Episodes.Title: The Day of Decision
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol successfully cancels the rehearsal and prevents Yi-chan from getting seriously hurt. Chairman Yoon extends the contract with Eun-gyeol and changes the terms and conditions. The day of the festival is finally here, and Se-gyeong has to choose between Eun-gyeol and Yi-chan. Chung-ah decides not to show up at the festival.

Episodes.Title: The Final Festival
Episodes.Description: As the enchanting glow of their festival fades, Eun-gyeol and Eun-yu acknowledge the depth of their feelings, hoping for a lasting connection. Meanwhile, the anticipated disbandment takes an unexpected turn, giving the boys another shot at the stage. The hurdle now is creating their own song, and Yi-chan suggests a gathering for this endeavor while musing on how to persuade Chung-ah to join.

Episodes.Title: Another Time Traveler
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol and Se-gyeong realize that they’re both time travelers. He learns that Se-gyeong also had a mission to accomplish while she was in 1995. Eun-gyeol finds out that Chung-ah has been confined and abused for the past 12 years. Meanwhile, Se-gyeong tells Eun-gyeol that Yi-chan’s accident didn’t happen on the day before the festival and that it hasn’t happened yet.

Episodes.Title: The Hints
Episodes.Description: Eun-yu drops clues about Yi-chan's real hearing loss incident to Eun-gyeol. Knowing that Eun-gyeol tends to shoulder blame for everything, she pledges to support him through this tough time. However, suspicions linger in her mind about the complexity of her connection with Eun-gyeol. Together, they methodically investigate everyone linked to the accident in search of the truth. Meanwhile, Yi-chan assures Eun-gyeol that he won't leave the house for the entire day.

Episodes.Title: Everything You Hoped for and More
Episodes.Description: Yi-chan gets hit by a car and loses his hearing. Master tells Eun-gyeol to go back to his time, but he refuses, determined to catch the guy who hit Yi-chan. Se-gyeong convinces Eun-gyeol to return to 2023, and when he finally does, a completely different life awaits him.
